query:
SELECT h.id, h.templateId, t.touchKey, h.changeNote, h.editedAt
FROM sequenceTemplateHistory h
JOIN sequenceTemplates t ON t.id = h.templateId
WHERE t.sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
ORDER BY h.id DESC
LIMIT 10;
